title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Rewriting a Printed Particular
content:
This reference describes the agent tool that writes a registered correction onto the printed particulars of an issued `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` record.

## What the tool does

A single use of `apply_particular_correction_a24e9121` rewrites exactly one printed particular of an issued transport document with new wording or a new figure, and marks the correction request that asked for it as completed. It books no fee and issues no new set of originals. Afterwards the document shows the corrected particular and the request shows the outcome completed.

## How it is invoked

It is a desk-side tool. The agent makes it available by unlocking it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, and then executes it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

- **`bl_id`**: the transport document to be corrected, named by the reference taken from the transport document lookup; a text identifier.
- **`booking_id`**: the booking that document covers; its reference appears on the document record and among the results of the booking lookup; a text identifier.
- **`request_id`**: the correction request on file for the document, identified by its reference from the documentation service request lookup; a text identifier.
- **`corrected_field`**: the particular being rewritten. It must be the particular named on the correction request, and it takes one of these values:
  - `consignee_name`: the consignee printed on the document
  - `notify_party_name`: the notify party printed on the document
  - `cargo_description`: the description of goods printed
  - `package_count`: the number of packages printed
  - `gross_weight_kg`: the gross cargo weight printed
  - `shipper_name`: the shipper printed
  - `port_of_discharge`: the port of discharge printed
- **`requested_value`**: the new wording or figure for that particular, copied character for character from the correction request on file, which holds it exactly as the customer supplied it. Every word, digit, space and punctuation mark is kept; nothing is translated, normalised, summarised, added or removed.

## Return

On success the tool returns one confirmation sentence naming the transport document reference, the particular corrected, the new printed value and the correction request reference now marked completed. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal.

## Contract Q&A

**Can one call change two particulars?** No. Each call rewrites one particular, the one named on the request.

**May the new wording be tidied, for example by correcting capitalisation?** No. It is taken verbatim from the request on file.

**Hypothetical input and return.** With `corrected_field` set to `notify_party_name` and `requested_value` set to "Elbe Logistik GmbH, Hamburg" on a document "BL-EXAMPLE" and request "REQ-EXAMPLE", a successful call replies that the notify party on "BL-EXAMPLE" now reads "Elbe Logistik GmbH, Hamburg" and that "REQ-EXAMPLE" is completed.
